instructions: Read the local PDF and source audit. Fill observations, page/section references, and any differences. Use not_specified for facts the paper does not report; never invent paper parameters. All unsupported equivalence claims remain blocked.

camera_and_units.evidence: Hughes et al. v2, Section III-C, PDF page 3, and Section III-E, PDF page 4. Source: docs/phase5/SCENARIO_FIDELITY.md and scenario_catalog.json camera fields.
camera_and_units.differences: The paper describes a simplified horizontal viewing angle gamma, with no occlusion or 3D camera frustum during planning. The recovered implementation uses ViewConeSensor with FOV pi/2, cutoff 100 with the cutoff test disabled. The numerical FOV is supported by source code, not established by paper Section III-C. The later source export includes an extra overview camera, which is excluded from historical robot counts. Rendered-image evaluation is distinct from planning.

motion_and_grid.evidence: Hughes et al. v2, Section III-A, PDF page 3. Source: docs/phase5/SCENARIO_FIDELITY.md and scenario_catalog.json grid and move_dist fields.
motion_and_grid.differences: The paper specifies a grid-bounded motion model, eight orientations, rotations of pi/4 per time step, and movement limited by distance D. The historical source specifies move_dist=3 and scenario-specific grid sizes. The numeric D=3 is source-supported, not established by paper Section III-A. No changes to the original movement constraints.
